scientific_integrity: Proof by exact endpoint-partition recurrence and strong induction; computational checks are corroboration, not a substitute for the proof. No empirical claim of global uniqueness in all literature.
scientific_limitations: Binary alphabet, linear words, distinct nonempty palindromic scattered-subsequence patterns; no larger-alphabet claim or positional-embedding count. The first ten binary entries had already been tabulated in 2021. Prior-literature comparison is bounded; no independent scientific audit.
title: Exact Fibonacci extrema and all maximizers for binary scattered palindromes
